=== Other currently-proposed experimental cmavo ===

* [[BPFK Section: Aspect]] contains a reference to [[xa'o|xa'o]]; it would be very strange to keep this reference without discussing whether or not this meaning and/or form should be added.
* The contents of [[Experimental cmavo|Experimental cmavo]], while rather haphazard, may be used a resource.

* [http://groups.google.com/group/lojban/browse_thread/thread/3462868aaa97e791 oi] is a suggested cmavo regarding frequency/numbering.
* [http://groups.google.com/group/lojban/browse_thread/thread/7ddd2e891bcdf27e oi'a and xoi'e] are two proposed ZAhO to do with increases over time. One is linear, the other exponential.

* [http://groups.google.com/group/lojban/browse_thread/thread/d67a31d055bdeb8c here is currently no 'opposite of inside' (outside)] as a tense in Lojban. I hereby propose we use ''te'i'' (came up with it from ''to'e ne'i'') to mean ''fi'o se bartu''.
* There's a whole page of proposals including an [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-index.php?page=Experimental+anaphorics fterthought prenex] (postnex?) marker. 'Experimental Anaphorics'

* [http://groups.google.com/group/lojban/browse_thread/thread/2d5a57839bf27984 u'ei] is a probability/sixth-dimensional tense of selma'o ROI.
* [http://groups.google.com/group/lojban/browse_thread/thread/e6d7a1a38cec7152 ai] is referring to multiple previously mentioned sumti.

* [http://groups.google.com/group/lojban/browse_thread/thread/e172020312f34fd6/2637613cc0a0d78f#2637613cc0a0d78f a'oi proposal]
